changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO REALM_BRAND (ID, REALM_ID, BRAND_ID, IS_DEFAULT) SELECT UUID(), r.ID, b.ID, 0 FROM REALM r JOIN BRAND b ON b.CODE = '9161455007713625991' WHERE r.NAME = 'user' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM REALM_BRAND rb WHERE rb.REALM_ID = r.ID AND rb.BRAND_ID = b.ID);
